# Rosehill Wine Cellars (concept by Kerblabs)

> Custom wine cellar design and build. Facts from rosehillwinecellars.com. This page is a free concept, not the company's own site.

## Facts
- Established 1995 (per their site); worldwide design and service.
- Canada showroom: 1686 Mattawa Avenue, Mississauga, ON L4X 1K2.
- USA office and showroom: 3940 Prospect Ave, #103, Naples, FL (contact page listed it as opening mid-November 2025; confirm current status).
- USA office phone: 239-402-1415. Toll-free 888-253-6807.
- USA hours listed: Tuesday to Friday 9am to 5pm, Saturday 10am to 4pm.

## Services
- Custom wine cellar design and build (personalized consultation, CAD design, in-house construction)
- Cellar consultation services
- Off-site wine storage
- Annual maintenance plans
- Wine coolers, cellar cooling systems, racking

- Contact: https://rosehillwinecellars.com/pages/contact
